editorial:
If you want a silly family adventure with familiar faces, this one brings back Manny, Sid, Diego, and the herd for another wild ride. Scrat's chase for his acorn blasts him into space, and that accident sends a huge asteroid toward Earth. The gang leaves home, travels to strange new places, and tries to stop the end of the world while still bickering, joking, and caring for each other. It feels bright, fast, and packed with cartoon energy, so younger viewers will likely stay entertained even when the story gets a little messy.

The animation is colorful, the voice cast is lively, and there are plenty of goofy jokes, but the plot can feel crowded and the science is pure cartoon nonsense. Some characters get too little time, and the emotional moments are lighter than earlier films. Still, if you want easy family fun, it works best as a casual watch with kids. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for a movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the herd reaches the crash site and uses the magnetic crystals to launch the asteroid back into space. Scrat's space antics help create the new moon, and the threat passes. Manny and Ellie celebrate their daughter's wedding, Sid finally finds love, and the whole group settles into a safer, happier life together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves easy animated family adventures.
